dod_buy.1 = {

	placement = root
	title = dod_buy.1.t
	desc = dod_buy.1.d
	flavor = dod_buy.1.f
	event_image = { video = "unspecific_signed_contract" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"
	duration = 3

	option = {
		name = dod_buy.1.a
		default_option = yes
		scope:dod_buy_buyer = { trigger_event = { id = dod_buy.2 days = 7 } }
		var:dod_buy_region = { every_scope_state = { limit = { owner = root } set_state_owner = scope:dod_buy_buyer } }
		dod_buy_payment = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 50 }
	}

	option = {
		name = dod_buy.1.b
		scope:dod_buy_buyer = { trigger_event = { id = dod_buy.3 days = 7 } }
		ai_chance = { base = 50 }
	}
}
